title: Closeout summary: Phase 04A - Workflow and skill directive adoption
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Phase 04A closes workflow and skill directive adoption. S04T01 updated canonical workflows to consume directive bundles, S04T02 updated generated skill adapters to require directive inspection, and S04T03 added workflow and installed-skill documentation tests plus repaired older workflows missing the directive section. Dependency tree shows no open descendants, and docs/tests/strict doctor validation passed.

Close reason: Phase 04A descendants are closed and directive adoption is covered by workflow, skill, docs, and doctor validation
